user.title: Connect to Etherscan
user.description: Enter your Etherscan API key. You can get a free key at etherscan.io/apis.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Etherscan
reauth_confirm.description: Your API key is no longer valid. Please enter a new one.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured

init.title: Ethereum Balance Options
init.description: Enter one wallet per line as Name:0xAddress (e.g. My Wallet:0x1234...abcd). The name is optional — if omitted, a shortened address is used.

error.invalid_address: One or more addresses are invalid. Use format: 0x followed by 40 hex characters.
